commercial_product.category: Diabetes injection devices (Becton Dickinson Diabetes Care spin-off, May 2022)
marketed_platforms: Safety pen needles and safety syringes for clinical settings
commercial_product.regulatory_status: FDA-cleared diabetes injection devices; sold globally to >30 million people in >100 countries.

excluded_legacy_terminated.status: FDA 510(k) cleared Sept 2024; program discontinued Nov 2024 in connection with restructuring; will not be commercially launched and closed-loop development halted.

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Embecta is a pure-play diabetes injection-device company spun off from Becton Dickinson in 2022. It markets pen needles and insulin syringes; it develops no proprietary drugs and sponsors no active P1/P2/P3 trials. Its sole investigational-device program (insulin patch pump) was discontinued in November 2024 after restructuring.
